items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You'd get out in somebody's backyard and dance on Napoleon.

ctx.x: No, we didn't play any. Not, not, not years ago. Most of that he played was lawn parties.
They used to call them lawn parties. You'd get out in somebody's backyard and dance on Napoleon. That's what you used to have to dance on.
Yeah, them was lawn parties. Did they sell drinks at lawn parties? Sure, did they sell drinks, for sure they sold drinks.
